title: Repo task parts
description: One card per repo: the open notes and sections of the repo are its parts (DOCS-repotask.md).

part.description: One part of a repo task. id is the part's section card id <note id8>-<index>. state: todo (waits), working (the run is on it now), done (ticked this cycle), human (a MANUAL WORK REQUIRED part the run skips), held (an older per-section run still owns it and keeps its own card). steps: the sub-steps Claude split it into (done of total), null without any.

body.description: The part's own text (its section's lines, or a section-less note's body); only in GET /api/task, the editor's start value.

edit.description: Whether kuhy may edit the part's title and text now (POST /api/task/<card>/part-edit, 856c0f0a): an unticked part the run has not reached. A disabled one carries its reason.
